queue.title: U.S. container imports break a four-year volume record in October, reports Descartes
queue.excerpt: U.S. container imports hit an all-time high in October as shipments from China rose for a fourth straight month. U.S. ports handled 2,674,808 twenty-foot equivalent units (TEUs), up 5% from September and 16% from a year earlier, according to Descartes’ November Global Shipping Report.

queue.title: Union Pacific police in shootout after alleged train robbery on southern California freight line
queue.excerpt: Two men were arrested after a shooting involving Union Pacific Railroad Police investigating suspected cargo theft near the busy Tehachapi Loop on Nov. 12. No injuries were reported, according to the Kern County Sheriff’s Office and reported in local media.

queue.title: ATA pushes for third-party certification in 6-step roadmap to combat ELD fraud
queue.excerpt: Faced with surging safety threats tied to hours-of-service manipulation, the American Trucking Associations (ATA) is pressing federal regulators to overhaul the nation's electronic logging device system through mandatory third-party oversight and rigorous digital surveillance.

queue.title: New logistics firm linked to collapsed R&R transportation empire
queue.excerpt: Members of the family behind the collapsed R&R Family of Companies are listed as executives of a newly established Pittsburgh-area logistics business, even as former R&R chief executive Richard Stephen Francis navigates personal Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings in Florida.
